model: model_state.json models.T1_B1; existing 25 rings, 7 controls, frozen float32 buffers cast to float64 arithmetic
perturbation: control index 1 chord-log increment, normalized to signed half-chord change at z=9.225 m; continuous B-spline weights and ring-interpolated base chord
centroid_formula: G=B C+c u/4; u=(-sin(twist),cos(twist)); exact compensating field f=-delta(c) u/4
projection: Minimize sum across all 25 rings and xy of |B_free deltaC_free-f|^2 with deltaC_0=0 and -5<C+deltaC<5. Solve rooted least squares, verify inactive bounds; fail rather than silently relax bounds. This is a function-space projection, not fitting image data.
diagnostic_positions: Report all 25 ring residuals; z=9.225 m continuous extension with fixed buffer interpolation; root band [6.15,12.3] m sampled at 247 fixed equal intervals including target; no tuning based on results.
reported_metrics: vector norm max and RMS in metres, coordinate RMS, signed control deltas and inherited bounds, continuous target residual; numerical exactness threshold 1e-10 m only for float64 algebra, not physical tolerance
regularization: Compute original formulas on C,ell; map actual Greville geometric center samples back to C and verify pullback equality. Also report naive same formulas on absolute G, template-relative H=G-D(0), and reference-axis samples A C to expose changed penalty, not suggested defaults.
reparameterization: A=B(Greville), G=A C+D_g(ell); C=A^-1(G-D_g(ell)), root G0=D0(ell), bounds inherited through inverse. G(z)=B(z)A^-1(G-D_g)+D_z, not B(z)G. Inspect invertibility only; no new fit implementation.
decision_rule: Nonzero best-projection residual prohibits claim of exact per-ring center-preserving original-family chord direction. Exact invertible coordinates with pullback objective preserve family, while direct interpolation/reused regularizer/fixed new independent boxes alter assumptions.
